# Load Packages

```{r}
# Load Package
library(quantmod)
library(tseries)
library(forecast)
library(Metrics)
library(dplyr)
library(keras)
library(tensorflow)
library(TSA)
library(rugarch)
```

# Load Data

```{r}
#data=read.table("d-sp55008.txt",header=T)
data=read.table("d-sp58010.txt",header=T)
print(data)
```

```{r}
data_ts <- ts(data$Close)
cat("数据长度:", length(data_ts), "个月\n")
print(summary(data_ts))
```

# 时序图

```{r}
# 绘制原始数据时序图
#par(mfrow=c(1,2))
plot(data_ts, main="Time Series Diagram: Raw Data", ylab="Closing Price", xlab="Time",
     col="blue", lwd=2)
grid()

# 对数变换（稳定方差）
log_data <- log(data_ts)
plot(log_data, main="Time Series Diagram: After Log Transformation", ylab="ln(Closing Price)", xlab="Time",
     col="darkgreen", lwd=2)
grid()
```

观察原序列图像及对数处理图像可以发现，对数处理可以在一定程度上缓解方差波动的问题。但序列仍存在明显的增长性，可以通过对序列进行分解直观观察。

```{r}
acf(data_ts, main="ACF: Raw Data", lag.max=20)
acf(log_data, main="ACF: After Log Transformation", lag.max=20)
```

```{r}
# 原始数据的ADF检验
library(fUnitRoots)
cat("原始数据ADF检验:\n")
fUnitRoots::adfTest(data_ts)
```

```{r}
# 对数数据的ADF检验
adf_log <- fUnitRoots::adfTest(log_data)
cat("\n对数数据ADF检验:\n")
print(adf_log)
```

一方面,原始数据和对数数据对应的自相关函数见上图。不管是对于原始数据还是对数数据,自相关函数都接近1，说明该过程具有长记忆性，从而不具有平稳性;另外一方面,对原始数据和对数数据进行ADF检验,得到的p值分别为0.9724和0.99,故认为原始数据和对数数据是不平稳的. 为了处理不平稳的数据,可以采用差分的方法.考虑对对数收盘价进行差分,这通常被称为对数收益率。

```{r}
# 一阶差分（去除趋势）
diff_data <- diff(log_data)
plot(diff_data, main="Time Series Diagram: Log Return", ylab="Log Return", xlab="Time",
     col="black", lwd=2)
grid()
abline(h=0, lty=2)#
```

对对数收益率进行ADF检验,所得的p值为0.01, 说明一次差分即可得到平稳的数据.

```{r}
# 差分后数据的ADF检验
adf_diff <- fUnitRoots::adfTest(diff_data)
cat("\n一阶差分后数据ADF检验:\n")
print(adf_diff)
```

```{r}
tsdisplay(diff_data, main="Log Return")
acf(diff_data, main="ACF: Log Return", lag.max=20)
pacf(diff_data, main="PACF: Log Return", lag.max=20)


```

在建立MA模型时,我们可以使用自相关函数(ACF)的图像来估计阶数;相应地,在建立AR模型时,我们可以使用偏自相关函数(PACF)的图像来估计阶数;对于ARMA模型而言, 使用ACF和PACF都难以解决问题,但可以用推广的自相关系数(EACF)来估计阶数.

```{r}
n <- length(diff_data)
train_size <- floor(0.8 * n)
test_size <- n - train_size

train_data <- diff_data[1:train_size]
test_data <- diff_data[(train_size+1):n]

cat("总样本数:", n, "\n")
cat("训练集:", train_size, "个观测\n")
cat("测试集:", test_size, "个观测\n\n")
```

ACF图和PACF图都没有明显的截尾和拖尾特征，对AR()和MA()的之后阶数不好判断，可以使用函数自动寻找最优模型。这里分别使用AIC和BIC准则进行寻找。

# AR

```{r}
# 使用AIC自动定阶
ar_order <- ar(train_data, method="mle")
cat("AIC自动选择的AR阶数:", ar_order$order, "\n\n")

# 拟合AR模型
ar_model <- arima(train_data, order=c(ar_order$order, 0, 0), include.mean=TRUE)

cat("AR模型估计结果:\n")
print(ar_model)
coefs <- ar_model$coef
se <- sqrt(diag(ar_model$var.coef))
t_values <- coefs / se # t-value
p_values <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(t_values))) # p-value
result <- data.frame(
  Estimate = coefs,
  StdError = se,
  t_value = t_values,
  p_value = p_values)
print(result)

```

```{r}
summary(ar_model)
```

```{r}
# AR模型诊断
cat("\n--- AR模型残差诊断 ---\n")
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
checkresiduals(ar_model, main="AR模型残差诊断")
# ✓ 残差为白噪声 (p-value > 0.05)

```

```{r}
plot(ar_model $ residuals, xlab = "t", ylab = "residuals") #残差图像
tsdiag(ar_model, gof.lag = 20) #残差的检验
qqnorm(ar_model $ residuals,main="QQ Plot: Residuals of AR(4) Model") #残差的QQ图
qqline(ar_model $ residuals)
Box.test(ar_model $ residuals, type = "Ljung-Box") #残差的LB检验
```

```{r}
# =======================================================
# 1. AR 模型预测与绘图
# =======================================================
# 绘制未来 100 步的预测图
plot(forecast(ar_model, 100), main = "AR Model Forecast (100 steps)")

# 生成与测试集长度一致的预测数据
ar_forecast <- forecast(ar_model, h=test_size)
ar_pred <- as.numeric(ar_forecast$mean)

# =======================================================
# 2. 计算误差指标
# =======================================================

# --- A. 样本内误差 (In-Sample Metrics) ---
# 直接从模型对象中提取 AIC
aic_ar <- AIC(ar_model)

# --- B. 样本外误差 (Out-of-Sample Metrics) ---
# MSE (均方误差)
mse_ar <- mean((test_data - ar_pred)^2)

# RMSE (均方根误差)
rmse_ar <- sqrt(mse_ar)

# MAE (平均绝对误差)
mae_ar <- mean(abs(test_data - ar_pred))

# MAPE (平均绝对百分比误差)
# 注意：收益率数据可能包含 0，加上 eps (1e-8) 防止除以零错误
eps <- 1e-8
mape_ar <- mean(abs((test_data - ar_pred) / (test_data + eps))) * 100

# =======================================================
# 3. 输出结果
# =======================================================
cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("          AR 模型性能评估结果\n")
cat("============================================\n")

cat("--- 样本内误差 (模型拟合优度) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("AIC (赤池信息准则):  %.4f\n", aic_ar))

cat("\n--- 样本外误差 (预测准确度) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("MSE  (均方误差):     %.9f\n", mse_ar))
cat(sprintf("RMSE (均方根误差):   %.9f\n", rmse_ar))
cat(sprintf("MAE  (平均绝对误差): %.9f\n", mae_ar))
cat(sprintf("MAPE (平均绝对百分比): %.2f%%\n", mape_ar))
cat("--------------------------------------------\n")

# 提示：对于收益率预测，MAPE 通常会很大，这是数据特性导致的
if(mape_ar > 100) {
  cat("注：由于收益率接近 0，MAPE 数值可能非常大，建议重点关注 MSE/MAE。\n")
}
```

# AR+GARCH

```{r}
library(FinTS)
# ARCH效应与GARCH模型
FinTS::ArchTest(residuals(ar_model))
```

```{r}
spec_ar <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
  mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(4, 0), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

# 2. 拟合模型 (使用你的训练集 train_data)
# 注意：solver='hybrid' 能提高收敛成功率
fit_ar_garch <- ugarchfit(spec = spec_ar, data = train_data, solver = 'hybrid')

# 3. 输出详细结果
print(fit_ar_garch)

# --- 关键结果解读指南 ---
# 1. 查看 "Optimal Parameters": 
#    - alpha1 (ARCH项) 和 beta1 (GARCH项) 的 P值是否 < 0.05？
#    - shape (t分布自由度) 是否显著？
# 2. 查看 "Weighted Ljung-Box Test on Standardized Residuals":
#    - P-value 是否都 > 0.05？(如果是，说明均值模型合格)
# 3. 查看 "Weighted Ljung-Box Test on Standardized Squared Residuals":
#    - P-value 是否都 > 0.05？(如果是，说明GARCH模型合格，波动率解释清楚了)
```

```{r}
# =======================================================
# 1. 生成预测 (Forecasting)
# =======================================================
# n.ahead: 预测步长，等于测试集长度
n_ahead <- length(test_data) 

# 进行滚动预测
ar_garch_forecast <- ugarchforecast(fit_ar_garch, n.ahead = n_ahead)

# =======================================================
# 2. 提取预测数据
# =======================================================
# fitted() 提取收益率预测值 (均值)
pred_mean_ar_garch <- as.numeric(fitted(ar_garch_forecast))

# sigma() 提取波动率预测值 (标准差)
pred_sigma_ar_garch <- as.numeric(sigma(ar_garch_forecast))

# =======================================================
# 3. 计算误差指标
# =======================================================

# --- A. 样本内误差 (In-Sample Metrics) ---
# 注意：AIC/BIC 是从拟合对象(fit_ar_garch)中提取，而不是预测对象
info_mat <- infocriteria(fit_ar_garch)
aic_garch <- info_mat[1] # Akaike
bic_garch <- info_mat[2] # Bayes

# --- B. 样本外误差 (Out-of-Sample Metrics) ---
# MSE (均方误差)
mse_garch <- mean((test_data - pred_mean_ar_garch)^2)

# RMSE (均方根误差)
rmse_garch <- sqrt(mse_garch)

# MAE (平均绝对误差)
mae_garch <- mean(abs(test_data - pred_mean_ar_garch))

# MAPE (平均绝对百分比误差)
# 加上 eps 防止除以 0
eps <- 1e-8 
mape_garch <- mean(abs((test_data - pred_mean_ar_garch) / (test_data + eps))) * 100

# =======================================================
# 4. 输出结果
# =======================================================
cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("      AR(4)-GARCH(1,1)  模型性能评估结果\n")
cat("============================================\n")

cat("--- 样本内误差 (模型拟合优度) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("AIC (赤池信息准则):  %.4f\n", aic_garch))
cat(sprintf("BIC (贝叶斯准则):    %.4f\n", bic_garch))

cat("\n--- 样本外误差 (预测准确度) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("MSE  (均方误差):     %.9f\n", mse_garch))
cat(sprintf("RMSE (均方根误差):   %.9f\n", rmse_garch))
cat(sprintf("MAE  (平均绝对误差): %.9f\n", mae_garch))
cat(sprintf("MAPE (平均绝对百分比): %.2f%%\n", mape_garch))
cat("--------------------------------------------\n")

# =======================================================
# 5. 绘制预测图 (类似 AR 模型的风格)
# =======================================================
# GARCH 的 rugarch 包自带 plot 方法是交互式的，不方便出报告。
# 这里我们手动绘制 "真实值 vs 预测均值 + 95%动态置信区间"
# -------------------------------------------------------

# 设定绘图范围 (Y轴)
ylim_range <- range(c(test_data, 
                      pred_mean_ar_garch + 2*pred_sigma_ar_garch, 
                      pred_mean_ar_garch - 2*pred_sigma_ar_garch))

# 1. 绘制真实测试集数据 (灰色线)
plot(as.numeric(test_data), type = "l", col = "gray", lwd = 1.5,
     ylim = ylim_range,
     main = "AR-GARCH Forecast vs Actual (with Dynamic 95% CI)",
     ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "Time (Test Set)")

# 2. 绘制 95% 置信区间 (虚线)
# 上界
lines(pred_mean_ar_garch + 2 * pred_sigma_ar_garch, col = "blue", lty = 2)
# 下界
lines(pred_mean_ar_garch - 2 * pred_sigma_ar_garch, col = "blue", lty = 2)

# 3. 绘制预测均值 (红色实线)
lines(pred_mean_ar_garch, col = "red", lwd = 2)

# 4. 添加图例
legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("Actual Data", "Forecast Mean", "95% Interval (Dynamic)"),
       col = c("gray", "red", "blue"), 
       lty = c(1, 1, 2), 
       lwd = c(1.5, 2, 1),
       cex = 0.8)

# 5. 添加说明
mtext("Note: Blue dashed lines show GARCH dynamic volatility", side=3, cex=0.8)
```

```{r}
# =======================================================
# 第三步：可视化 (预测值 vs 真实值 + 动态风险区间)
# =======================================================
library(ggplot2)

# 1. 整理绘图数据
plot_df <- data.frame(
  Time = 1:n_ahead,
  Actual = as.numeric(test_data),
  Predicted = pred_mean_ar,
  # 95% 置信区间 = 均值 +/- 2倍动态标准差
  # 这体现了 GARCH 的价值：波动大时区间变宽
  Lower = pred_mean_ar - 2 * pred_sigma_ar,
  Upper = pred_mean_ar + 2 * pred_sigma_ar
)

# 2. 为了清晰，只画前 200 个点 (或改为 n_ahead 画全部)
subset_n <- min(200, n_ahead)

ggplot(plot_df[1:subset_n, ], aes(x = Time)) +
  # 绘制真实值 (黑色虚线)
  geom_line(aes(y = Actual, color = "Actual Return"), size = 0.5, alpha = 0.7) +
  
  # 绘制预测均值 (红色实线)
  geom_line(aes(y = Predicted, color = "Predicted Mean"), size = 0.8) +
  
  # 绘制 95% 动态置信区间 (灰色阴影)
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper, fill = "95% Confidence Interval"), alpha = 0.2) +
  
  # 颜色和标签设置
  scale_color_manual(name = "Legend", values = c("Actual Return" = "black", "Predicted Mean" = "red")) +
  scale_fill_manual(name = "", values = c("95% Confidence Interval" = "red")) +
  
  labs(
    title = "AR(4)-GARCH(1,1) Forecast with Dynamic Volatility",
    subtitle = "Notice how the confidence interval (grey area) expands when volatility increases",
    y = "Log Returns",
    x = "Time (Test Set Index)"
  ) +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "bottom")
```

```{r}
# =======================================================
# 1. 准备数据与预测
# =======================================================
# 设定预测步数 (比如你图中的 100 步)
n_ahead <- 100 

# 使用你拟合好的 AR-GARCH 模型进行预测
# fit_ar_garch 是你上一步用 rugarch 拟合好的模型对象
fc_garch <- ugarchforecast(fit_ar_garch, n.ahead = n_ahead)

# 提取预测的均值 (Predicted Mean) 和 波动率 (Sigma)
pred_mean <- as.numeric(fitted(fc_garch))
pred_sigma <- as.numeric(sigma(fc_garch))

# =======================================================
# 2. 准备绘图数据 (拼接历史和未来)
# =======================================================
# 提取历史数据
history_data <- as.numeric(train_data) 
n_history <- length(history_data)

# 生成未来的时间轴索引
future_index <- (n_history + 1):(n_history + n_ahead)

# 计算 95% 置信区间 (均值 +/- 2倍条件标准差)
# 这里的"宽度"是由 GARCH 模型算出来的，会随风险变化
upper_bound <- pred_mean + 2 * pred_sigma
lower_bound <- pred_mean - 2 * pred_sigma

# =======================================================
# 3. 开始绘图 (仿照 forecast 包的风格)
# =======================================================
# 步骤 A: 画空白框和历史数据
# xlim 设置为 历史长度 + 预测长度，给后面留出位置
plot(history_data, type = "l", col = "black", lwd = 1,
     xlim = c(1, n_history + n_ahead), 
     main = "Forecasts from AR(4)-GARCH(1,1)",
     ylab = "Returns", xlab = "Time")

# 步骤 B: 画预测的置信区间 (阴影部分)
# 使用 polygon 函数绘制半透明的阴影
# 颜色 rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3) 代表蓝色，0.3是透明度
polygon(c(future_index, rev(future_index)), 
        c(upper_bound, rev(lower_bound)), 
        col = rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3), border = NA)

# 步骤 C: 画预测均值线 (中间的蓝线)
lines(future_index, pred_mean, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

# 添加一条图例
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("History", "Forecast", "95% Interval"),
       col = c("black", "blue", rgb(0, 0, 1, 0.3)), 
       lty = c(1, 1, 1), lwd = c(1, 2, 10))
```

# ARMA

```{r}
# 使用auto.arima自动选择最优ARMA模型
arma_model <- auto.arima(train_data, max.p=10, start.p=10,
                         max.q=10, start.q=0,
                         ic="aic", seasonal= FALSE,
                        trace=TRUE,stepwise=TRUE,approximation = FALSE)

cat("\nARMA模型估计结果:\n")
print(arma_model)
coefs <- arma_model$coef
se <- sqrt(diag(arma_model$var.coef))
t_values <- coefs / se # t-value
p_values <- 2 * (1 - pnorm(abs(t_values))) # p-value
result <- data.frame(
  Estimate = coefs,
  StdError = se,
  t_value = t_values,
  p_value = p_values)
print(result)

```

```{r}
# ARMA模型诊断
cat("\n--- ARMA模型残差诊断 ---\n")
par(mfrow=c(2,2))
checkresiduals(arma_model, main="ARMA模型残差诊断")

```

```{r}
plot(arma_model $ residuals, xlab = "t", ylab = "residuals") #残差图像
tsdiag(arma_model, gof.lag = 20) #残差的检验
qqnorm(arma_model $ residuals,main="QQ Plot: Residuals of ARMA(2,1) Model") #残差的QQ图
qqline(arma_model $ residuals)
Box.test(arma_model $ residuals, type = "Ljung-Box") #残差的LB检验
```

```{r}
# =======================================================
# 1. ARMA 模型预测与绘图
# =======================================================
# 绘制未来 100 步的预测图 (带置信区间)
plot(forecast(arma_model, 100), 
     main = "ARMA Model Forecast (Next 100 Steps)",
     ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "Time")

# 生成与测试集长度一致的预测数据
arma_forecast <- forecast(arma_model, h=test_size)
arma_pred <- as.numeric(arma_forecast$mean)

# =======================================================
# 2. 计算误差指标
# =======================================================

# --- A. 样本内误差 (In-Sample Metrics) ---
# 从 arima 对象中直接提取 AIC 和 BIC
aic_arma <- AIC(arma_model)
bic_arma <- BIC(arma_model)

# --- B. 样本外误差 (Out-of-Sample Metrics) ---
# MSE (均方误差)
mse_arma <- mean((test_data - arma_pred)^2)

# RMSE (均方根误差)
rmse_arma <- sqrt(mse_arma)

# MAE (平均绝对误差)
mae_arma <- mean(abs(test_data - arma_pred))

# MAPE (平均绝对百分比误差)
# 添加 eps 防止除以 0 (收益率数据常见问题)
eps <- 1e-8
mape_arma <- mean(abs((test_data - arma_pred) / (test_data + eps))) * 100

# =======================================================
# 3. 输出结果
# =======================================================
cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("         ARMA 模型性能评估结果\n")
cat("============================================\n")

cat("--- 样本内误差 (模型拟合优度) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("AIC (赤池信息准则):  %.4f\n", aic_arma))
cat(sprintf("BIC (贝叶斯准则):    %.4f\n", bic_arma))

cat("\n--- 样本外误差 (预测准确度) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("MSE  (均方误差):     %.9f\n", mse_arma))
cat(sprintf("RMSE (均方根误差):   %.9f\n", rmse_arma))
cat(sprintf("MAE  (平均绝对误差): %.9f\n", mae_arma))
cat(sprintf("MAPE (平均绝对百分比): %.2f%%\n", mape_arma))


```

# ARMA+GARCH

残差分析

```{r}
library(FinTS)
# ARCH效应与GARCH模型
FinTS::ArchTest(residuals(arma_model))
```

模型的残差序列存在arch效应。考虑建立Garch模型,

```{r}

r_garch=garch(x=residuals(arma_model), order=c(1,1) ,reltol=0.000001)
summary(r_garch)
```

所有系数均显著。Jarque Bera检验的结果表明Garch模型的残差是非正态的，而Box-Ljung检验的结果表明残差的平方是白噪声序列。

```{r}
plot(residuals(r_garch),type='h',ylab='standard residuals')
acf(residuals(r_garch)^2,na.action=na.omit)

gBox(r_garch,method='squared')
# 4. 代替 gBox 进行检验 (Ljung-Box Test)
# 对“平方标准化残差”做检验
# p-value > 0.05 才算通过

```

模型的残差看起来很正常。

残差平方序列看起来没有自相关性。

Generalized Portmanteau Tests for GARCH Models也都未显著。

1.  **残差非正态**：QQ图和 Jarque-Bera 检验都表明残差有厚尾（Heavy-tailed），不服从正态分布。

2.  **存在 ARCH 效应**：ArchTest 拒绝原假设，说明方差不恒定，存在波动率聚集。

3.  **模型选择**：在 ARMA 基础上建立 GARCH 模型是正确的方向。

**但是， tseries::garch 函数有两个局限性**：

1.  它是**分步估计**（先定 ARMA 算残差，再对残差算 GARCH），这在统计上不如**联合估计**（同时估计 ARMA 和 GARCH 参数）有效。

2.  它默认假设**正态分布**，无法解决你发现的“厚尾”问题（QQ图两端偏离）。

为了完善你的分析，建议使用 **rugarch 包** 来建立 **ARMA(2,1)-GARCH(1,1)** 模型（使用 Student-t 分布以适应厚尾），并进行预测和绘图。

```{r}

spec <- ugarchspec(
  variance.model = list(model = "sGARCH", garchOrder = c(1, 1)),
  mean.model = list(armaOrder = c(2, 1), include.mean = TRUE),
  distribution.model = "std"
)

# 2. 拟合模型 (使用训练集 train_data)
# 注意：train_data 应该是你 PDF 第6页定义的差分后的训练数据
garch_fit_final <- ugarchfit(spec = spec, data = train_data)

# 3. 输出拟合结果
print(garch_fit_final)

```

```{r}
cat("\n--- Ljung-Box 检验 (标准化残差) ---\n")
std_resid <- residuals(garch_fit, standardize = TRUE)

# 对标准化残差做 Ljung-Box 检验 (看是否有未提取的均值信息)
lb_mean <- Box.test(std_resid, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")
print(lb_mean)

# 对标准化残差的平方做 Ljung-Box 检验 (看是否还有未提取的波动信息)
lb_var <- Box.test(std_resid^2, lag = 20, type = "Ljung-Box")
cat("\n--- Ljung-Box 检验 (标准化残差平方) ---\n")
print(lb_var)

```

因此，对arma模型的残差建立Garch(1,1)模型进行拟合是合适的。

基于Garch(1,1)画出条件方差图。

```{r}
plot((fitted(r_garch)[,1])^2,type='l',ylab='conditional variance',xlab='t')
```

上图显而易见，arma(2,1)的残差的方差确实会随时间变化（方差非齐），残差包含了标准普尔500指数方差集群信息，这对我们观察经济波动很有帮助。

模型预测，画出预测图，对比训练集和测试集的预测精度

```{r}


# =======================================================
# 1. 进行预测 (Forecasting)
# =======================================================
n_ahead <- length(test_data) 
arma_garch_forecast <- ugarchforecast(garch_fit_final, n.ahead = n_ahead)

# =======================================================
# 2. 提取数据
# =======================================================
pred_mean <- as.numeric(fitted(arma_garch_forecast))
pred_sigma <- as.numeric(sigma(arma_garch_forecast))

# =======================================================
# 3. 计算误差指标
# =======================================================

# --- A. 样本内误差 (In-Sample Metrics) ---
# 提取信息准则矩阵
info_mat <- infocriteria(garch_fit_final)

# 提取 AIC (Akaike) - 通常在第 1 行
aic_value <- info_mat[1]

# 提取 BIC (Bayes) - 通常在第 2 行 (顺便提取，供参考)
bic_value <- info_mat[2]

# --- B. 样本外误差 (Out-of-Sample Metrics) ---
# MSE (均方误差)
mse_garch <- mean((test_data - pred_mean)^2)

# RMSE (均方根误差)
rmse_garch <- sqrt(mse_garch)

# MAE (平均绝对误差)
mae_garch <- mean(abs(test_data - pred_mean))

# MAPE (平均绝对百分比误差)
# 加上 eps 防止除以 0
eps <- 1e-8 
mape_garch <- mean(abs((test_data - pred_mean) / (test_data + eps))) * 100

# =======================================================
# 4. 输出结果
# =======================================================
cat("\n============================================\n")
cat("      ARMA-GARCH 模型性能评估结果\n")
cat("============================================\n")

cat("--- 样本内误差 (模型拟合优度) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("AIC (赤池信息准则):  %.4f\n", aic_value))
cat(sprintf("BIC (贝叶斯准则):    %.4f\n", bic_value))

cat("\n--- 样本外误差 (预测准确度) ---\n")
cat(sprintf("MSE  (均方误差):     %.9f\n", mse_garch))
cat(sprintf("RMSE (均方根误差):   %.9f\n", rmse_garch))
cat(sprintf("MAE  (平均绝对误差): %.9f\n", mae_garch))
cat(sprintf("MAPE (平均绝对百分比): %.2f%%\n", mape_garch))
cat("--------------------------------------------\n")
```

```{r}
library(rugarch)

# =======================================================
# 1. 生成未来 100 步的预测
# =======================================================
n_future <- 100
# garch_fit_final 是你之前拟合好的对象
fc_future <- ugarchforecast(garch_fit_final, n.ahead = n_future)

# =======================================================
# 2. 提取均值和波动率
# =======================================================
f_mu    <- as.numeric(fitted(fc_future)) # 预测的收益率均值
f_sigma <- as.numeric(sigma(fc_future))  # 预测的波动率 (标准差)

# =======================================================
# 3. 计算符合 Student-t 分布的 95% 置信区间
# =======================================================
# 关键步骤：提取自由度 (shape)，因为你用了 std 分布
# 如果你用的是正态分布 (norm)，shape 参数可能不存在，需要做个判断
model_params <- coef(garch_fit_final)

if("shape" %in% names(model_params)) {
  # 如果是 Student-t 分布
  df_shape <- model_params["shape"]
  # 计算 t 分布的 0.975 分位点 (双尾 95%)
  # rugarch 包提供了 qdist 函数方便计算
  crit_val <- qdist(distribution = "std", p = 0.975, mu = 0, sigma = 1, shape = df_shape)
  cat(sprintf("使用 Student-t 分布临界值: %.4f (自由度: %.2f)\n", crit_val, df_shape))
} else {
  # 如果是正态分布
  crit_val <- 1.96
  cat("使用正态分布临界值: 1.96\n")
}

# 计算上下界
upper_bound <- f_mu + crit_val * f_sigma
lower_bound <- f_mu - crit_val * f_sigma

# =======================================================
# 4. 准备绘图数据 (拼接历史尾部 + 未来预测)
# =======================================================
# 为了看清衔接，我们取历史数据的最后 50 个点
last_n <- 50
history_tail <- tail(as.numeric(train_data), last_n)

# 构造绘图用的整体坐标
# 时间轴：1 ~ (50 + 100)
all_data_len <- last_n + n_future
time_axis <- 1:all_data_len

# 构造绘图数据向量，前面是历史，后面是 NA (留给预测填补)
plot_history <- c(history_tail, rep(NA, n_future))

# 构造预测向量，前面是 NA，后面是预测值
plot_pred <- c(rep(NA, last_n), f_mu)
# 为了线条连续，把预测的第一点设为历史的最后一点 (可选，视觉优化)
plot_pred[last_n] <- history_tail[last_n] 

# 构造置信区间向量 (前面NA，后面区间)
plot_upper <- c(rep(NA, last_n), upper_bound)
plot_lower <- c(rep(NA, last_n), lower_bound)
# 视觉连续性处理
plot_upper[last_n] <- history_tail[last_n]
plot_lower[last_n] <- history_tail[last_n]

# =======================================================
# 5. 绘制精美图表
# =======================================================
# 确定 Y 轴范围，确保包含所有波动
y_limits <- range(c(history_tail, upper_bound, lower_bound), na.rm = TRUE)

# A. 绘制空白画布
plot(time_axis, plot_history, type = "n", ylim = y_limits,
     main = "ARMA-GARCH Forecast (Next 100 Steps)",
     ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "Time Steps (Last 50 History + 100 Future)")

# B. 绘制置信区间 (阴影部分)
# 只需要绘制后半部分
future_x <- last_n:all_data_len
polygon(c(future_x, rev(future_x)), 
        c(plot_upper[future_x], rev(plot_lower[future_x])),
        col = rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.15), border = NA) # 红色半透明

# C. 绘制置信区间边缘线 (虚线)
lines(plot_upper, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 1)
lines(plot_lower, col = "red", lty = 2, lwd = 1)

# D. 绘制历史数据 (黑色实线)
lines(plot_history, col = "black", lwd = 1.5)

# E. 绘制预测均值 (蓝色实线)
lines(plot_pred, col = "blue", lwd = 2)

# F. 添加分界线
abline(v = last_n, col = "gray", lty = 3)
text(last_n, max(y_limits), "Forecast Start", pos = 4, cex = 0.8, col="gray")

# G. 图例
legend("topleft", 
       legend = c("History", "Forecast Mean", "95% Dynamic CI"),
       col = c("black", "blue", "red"), 
       lty = c(1, 1, 2), 
       lwd = c(1.5, 2, 1), 
       fill = c(NA, NA, rgb(1, 0, 0, 0.15)), border = NA)
```

```{r}
# 2. 绘图：预测值 vs 真实值
# 为了看清细节，我们只画最后 100 个点，或者画整个测试集
library(ggplot2)

# 创建绘图数据框
plot_df <- data.frame(
  Time = 1:length(test_data),
  Actual = as.numeric(test_data),
  Predicted = pred_mean,
  Upper = pred_mean + 2 * pred_sigma, # 95% 置信区间上限 (考虑了波动率变化)
  Lower = pred_mean - 2 * pred_sigma  # 95% 置信区间下限
)

# 绘制预测对比图 (带置信区间)
ggplot(plot_df, aes(x = Time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Actual), color = "black", alpha = 0.5, size = 0.5) + # 真实值
  geom_line(aes(y = Predicted), color = "red", size = 0.8) +             # 预测均值
  geom_ribbon(aes(ymin = Lower, ymax = Upper), fill = "red", alpha = 0.2) + # 动态置信区间
  labs(title = "ARMA-GARCH Model Forecast vs Actual",
       subtitle = "Red Line: Forecast, Grey Area: 95% Confidence Interval (Dynamic Volatility)",
       y = "Log Returns (Diff)", x = "Time (Test Set Index)") +
  theme_minimal()

# 3. 解释图形
# GARCH 模型的优势在于它能预测“风险”。
# 你会发现红色的置信区间带（Confidence Interval）不是等宽的，
# 而是随着市场波动而忽大忽小，这正是 GARCH 模型捕捉到了方差聚类效应的表现。
```

#### 2. 结果分析与合理性判断

-   **模型修正的必要性**：最初的 ARMA 模型虽然消除了序列的自相关性（Ljung-Box Test 通过），但无法解释方差的波动（ARCH Test 拒绝）。引入 GARCH 模型后，能够解释波动率聚集现象。

-   **误差分析**：

    -   在 **MSE/MAE (均值预测)** 上，ARMA-GARCH 可能与纯 ARMA 差别不大，甚至略高一点点。这是正常的！因为 GARCH 主要改善的是**方差预测（风险评估）**，而不是均值预测。

    -   **AIC (赤池信息准则)**：联合估计的 ARMA-GARCH 模型的 AIC 通常会比单跑 ARMA 的 AIC 更低（即更好），说明在考虑了波动率后，模型对数据的整体拟合度更高。

-   **预测图**：ARMA-GARCH 的预测图不仅给出了点预测，还给出了随时间变化的置信区间，这对于金融风险管理（如计算 VaR）比单纯的点预测更有价值。

#### 结论

经过一系列检验与修正，**ARMA(2,1)-GARCH(1,1) (with Student-t distribution)** 是描述该 S&P 500 收益率序列的最优模型。残差检验显示其已为白噪声，且模型成功捕捉了厚尾和波动聚集特征。

```{r}
library(ggplot2)

cat("\n=== 简单交易策略回测 ===\n")

# 策略逻辑: 
# 如果模型预测均值 > 0，则做多 (持仓)
# 如果模型预测均值 < 0，则做空 (或空仓，这里假设做空)
signals <- ifelse(pred_mean > 0, 1, -1)

# 计算策略收益 = 信号 * 真实收益
# (假设第二天以开盘价买入，收盘价卖出，这里简化为直接获得当天收益)
strategy_returns <- signals * test_data
bh_returns <- test_data # Buy and Hold (买入持有) 策略

# 计算累计收益曲线
cumulative_strategy <- cumprod(1 + strategy_returns)
cumulative_bh <- cumprod(1 + bh_returns)

# 绘图数据准备
backtest_df <- data.frame(
  Time = 1:length(test_data),
  Strategy = cumulative_strategy,
  BuyHold = cumulative_bh
)

# 绘制累计收益对比图
ggplot(backtest_df, aes(x = Time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Strategy, color = "ARMA-GARCH Strategy"), size = 1) +
  geom_line(aes(y = BuyHold, color = "Buy & Hold (S&P 500)"), size = 0.8, linetype = "dashed") +
  labs(title = "Trading Strategy Backtest",
       subtitle = "Cumulative Returns: Model vs Market",
       y = "Cumulative Return (1.0 = Start)",
       color = "Strategy") +
  theme_minimal() +
  theme(legend.position = "top")
```

```{r}
cat("\n=== Value at Risk (VaR) 验证 ===\n")

# 提取模型预测的 Sigma (波动率)
# pred_sigma 来自 PDF 之前的代码
# 提取 Student-t 分布的形状参数 (shape parameter)
dist_shape <- coef(garch_fit_final)["shape"]

# 计算 5% 的分位数 (对于 Student-t 分布)
# qdist 是 rugarch 包里的函数，用于获取标准化残差的分位数
t_quantile <- qdist("std", p = 0.05, shape = dist_shape, mu = 0, sigma = 1)

# 计算动态 VaR (95% 置信度)
# VaR_5% = 预测均值 + 预测波动率 * t分布的5%分位点
# 注意: t_quantile 通常是负数 (例如 -1.65 或更低)
VaR_95 <- pred_mean + pred_sigma * t_quantile

# 统计“爆仓”次数 (实际收益率低于 VaR 的次数)
exceedances <- sum(test_data < VaR_95)
total_days <- length(test_data)
actual_ratio <- exceedances / total_days

cat(sprintf("测试集总天数: %d\n", total_days))
cat(sprintf("实际跌破 VaR 阈值次数: %d\n", exceedances))
cat(sprintf("实际违约率 (Failure Rate): %.4f (理论应接近 0.05)\n", actual_ratio))

# Kupiec 检验 (简单的概念性判断)
if (actual_ratio > 0.04 && actual_ratio < 0.06) {
  cat("结论: 模型对风险的估计非常准确 (在 4%-6% 之间)。\n")
} else if (actual_ratio >= 0.06) {
  cat("结论: 模型低估了风险 (实际跌破次数过多)。\n")
} else {
  cat("结论: 模型高估了风险 (实际跌破次数过少，模型过于保守)。\n")
}

# 绘图展示 VaR 穿透
plot(test_data, type = "l", col = "gray", main = "VaR Backtesting (Red Line = 95% VaR)", ylab = "Returns")
lines(VaR_95, col = "red", lwd = 2)
# 标记穿透点
points(which(test_data < VaR_95), test_data[test_data < VaR_95], col = "blue", pch = 20)
legend("bottomleft", legend = c("Actual Returns", "95% VaR", "Exceedance"), 
       col = c("gray", "red", "blue"), lty = c(1, 1, NA), pch = c(NA, NA, 20))
```

```{r}
library(forecast)
library(ggplot2)

# ==========================================
# 1. 准备数据
# ==========================================
# 确保你有 test_data (测试集) 和之前的模型对象
# ar_model: 你之前拟合的 AR(4)
# arma_model: 你之前拟合的 ARMA(2,1)

# 预测步长 (等于测试集长度)
n_ahead <- length(test_data)

# ==========================================
# 2. AR 模型预测与绘图
# ==========================================
# 进行预测
ar_fc <- forecast(ar_model, h = n_ahead)

# 转换为绘图数据
df_ar <- data.frame(
  Time = 1:n_ahead,
  Actual = as.numeric(test_data),
  Predicted = as.numeric(ar_fc$mean),
  Lower = as.numeric(ar_fc$lower[,2]), # 95% 置信区间下限
  Upper = as.numeric(ar_fc$upper[,2])  # 95% 置信区间上限
)

# 绘制 AR 模型预测图 (只显示前 200 个点以看清细节，如果想看全部请去掉 [1:200,])
subset_n <- min(200, n_ahead) 

p1 <- ggplot(df_ar[1:subset_n, ], aes(x = Time)) +
  geom_line(aes(y = Actual, color = "Actual"), alpha = 0.6) +

print(p1)

# ==========================================
# 3. ARMA 模型预测与绘图

# 转换为绘图数据
df_arma <- data.frame(
  Time = 1:n_ahead,
  Actual = as.numeric(test_data),
  Predicted = as.numeric(arma_fc$mean),
  Lower = as.numeric(arma_fc$lower[,2]),
  Upper = as.numeric(arma_fc$upper[,2])
)

# 绘制 ARMA 模型预测图

print(p2)

print(p3)
```

## 整个预测图

```{r}
# ==========================================
# 步骤 1: 准备全量预测数据 (修复 $ 报错)
# ==========================================
n_ahead <- length(test_data) # 获取测试集总长度

# --- 1. AR(4) 全量预测 ---
# 重新运行预测以确保对象结构正确
ar_obj_full <- predict(ar_model, n.ahead = n_ahead)
# 提取均值和标准误 (转为纯数字向量)
ar_mean <- as.numeric(ar_obj_full$pred)
ar_se   <- as.numeric(ar_obj_full$se)

# --- 2. ARMA(2,1) 全量预测 ---
arma_obj_full <- predict(arma_model, n.ahead = n_ahead)
arma_mean <- as.numeric(arma_obj_full$pred)
arma_se   <- as.numeric(arma_obj_full$se)

# --- 3. AR-GARCH 全量预测 ---
# 提取拟合值(均值)和条件标准差(波动率)
# 注意：这里假设您的GARCH预测对象名叫 ar_garch_forecast
arg_mean  <- as.numeric(fitted(ar_garch_forecast))
arg_sigma <- as.numeric(sigma(ar_garch_forecast))

# --- 4. ARMA-GARCH 全量预测 ---
armag_mean  <- as.numeric(fitted(arma_garch_forecast))
armag_sigma <- as.numeric(sigma(arma_garch_forecast))

# ==========================================
# 步骤 2: 绘制四图合一 (全时段)
# ==========================================
# 设置 2x2 画布
#par(mfrow = c(2, 2))
#par(mar = c(3, 4, 3, 1)) # 调整边距: 下 左 上 右

# 统一的时间轴
x_axis <- 1:n_ahead

# ------------ 图1: AR(4) ------------
# 动态计算Y轴范围，保证线条不溢出
ylim_1 <- range(c(test_data, ar_mean + 2*ar_se, ar_mean - 2*ar_se))

plot(x_axis, as.numeric(test_data), type = "l", col = "gray70", lwd = 0.8, ylim = ylim_1,
     main = "AR(4) Model (Full Test Set)", ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "")
# 添加 95% 静态区间 (AR的方差最后会趋于常数，几乎是平行的)
lines(x_axis, ar_mean + 2*ar_se, col = "blue", lty = 2, lwd = 1)
lines(x_axis, ar_mean - 2*ar_se, col = "blue", lty = 2, lwd = 1)
# 添加预测均值 (红色)
lines(x_axis, ar_mean, col = "red", lwd = 1.2)
legend("topleft", c("Actual", "Mean Forecast", "Static 95% CI"), 
       col=c("gray70", "red", "blue"), lty=c(1,1,2), cex=0.7, bty="n")

# ------------ 图2: ARMA(2,1) ------------
ylim_2 <- range(c(test_data, arma_mean + 2*arma_se, arma_mean - 2*arma_se))

plot(x_axis, as.numeric(test_data), type = "l", col = "gray70", lwd = 0.8, ylim = ylim_2,
     main = "ARMA(2,1) Model (Full Test Set)", ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "")
lines(x_axis, arma_mean + 2*arma_se, col = "blue", lty = 2, lwd = 1)
lines(x_axis, arma_mean - 2*arma_se, col = "blue", lty = 2, lwd = 1)
lines(x_axis, arma_mean, col = "red", lwd = 1.2)
legend("topleft", c("Actual", "Mean Forecast", "Static 95% CI"), 
       col=c("gray70", "red", "blue"), lty=c(1,1,2), cex=0.7, bty="n")

# ------------ 图3: AR-GARCH ------------
ylim_3 <- range(c(test_data, arg_mean + 2*arg_sigma, arg_mean - 2*arg_sigma))

plot(x_axis, as.numeric(test_data), type = "l", col = "gray70", lwd = 0.8, ylim = ylim_3,
     main = "AR-GARCH (Full Test Set)", ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "")
# 添加动态区间 (随波动率收缩/膨胀)
lines(x_axis, arg_mean + 2*arg_sigma, col = "blue", lty = 2, lwd = 0.8)
lines(x_axis, arg_mean - 2*arg_sigma, col = "blue", lty = 2, lwd = 0.8)
lines(x_axis, arg_mean, col = "red", lwd = 1.2)
legend("topleft", c("Actual", "Mean Forecast", "Dynamic GARCH CI"), 
       col=c("gray70", "red", "blue"), lty=c(1,1,2), cex=0.7, bty="n")

# ------------ 图4: ARMA-GARCH ------------
ylim_4 <- range(c(test_data, armag_mean + 2*armag_sigma, armag_mean - 2*armag_sigma))

plot(x_axis, as.numeric(test_data), type = "l", col = "gray70", lwd = 0.8, ylim = ylim_4,
     main = "ARMA-GARCH (Full Test Set)", ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "")
lines(x_axis, armag_mean + 2*armag_sigma, col = "blue", lty = 2, lwd = 0.8)
lines(x_axis, armag_mean - 2*armag_sigma, col = "blue", lty = 2, lwd = 0.8)
lines(x_axis, armag_mean, col = "red", lwd = 1.2)
legend("topleft", c("Actual", "Mean Forecast", "Dynamic GARCH CI"), 
       col=c("gray70", "red", "blue"), lty=c(1,1,2), cex=0.7, bty="n")

# 恢复默认画布设置
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```

## 后200天的预测图

```{r}
# ==========================================
# 步骤 1: 重新生成预测对象 (确保结构正确)
# ==========================================
# 获取测试集长度
n_ahead_steps <- length(test_data)

# 1. AR 模型预测 (这里生成的是一个列表，包含 pred 和 se)
ar_forecast_obj <- predict(ar_model, n.ahead = n_ahead_steps)
# 提取数据
ar_mean_full <- as.numeric(ar_forecast_obj$pred) # 均值
ar_se_full   <- as.numeric(ar_forecast_obj$se)   # 标准误

# 2. ARMA 模型预测
arma_forecast_obj <- predict(arma_model, n.ahead = n_ahead_steps)
# 提取数据
arma_mean_full <- as.numeric(arma_forecast_obj$pred)
arma_se_full   <- as.numeric(arma_forecast_obj$se)

# 3. GARCH 模型预测 (AR-GARCH 和 ARMA-GARCH)
# 注意：你需要确保内存里有拟合好的 fit 对象 (fit_ar_garch, fit_arma_garch)
# 或者已经是 forecast 对象
arg_mean_full  <- as.numeric(fitted(ar_garch_forecast))
arg_sigma_full <- as.numeric(sigma(ar_garch_forecast))

armag_mean_full  <- as.numeric(fitted(arma_garch_forecast))
armag_sigma_full <- as.numeric(sigma(arma_garch_forecast))

# ==========================================
# 步骤 2: 数据切片 (只取最后 200 个点)
# ==========================================
subset_n <- 200
total_len <- n_ahead_steps
# 计算最后 200 个点的索引位置
idx <- (total_len - subset_n + 1):total_len

# 提取测试集真值 (切片)
y_real_subset <- as.numeric(test_data[idx])

# 提取各模型预测值 (切片)
ar_mean_sub   <- ar_mean_full[idx]
ar_se_sub     <- ar_se_full[idx]

arma_mean_sub <- arma_mean_full[idx]
arma_se_sub   <- arma_se_full[idx]

arg_mean_sub   <- arg_mean_full[idx]
arg_sigma_sub  <- arg_sigma_full[idx]

armag_mean_sub   <- armag_mean_full[idx]
armag_sigma_sub  <- armag_sigma_full[idx]

# ==========================================
# 步骤 3: 绘图 (2行2列)
# ==========================================
#par(mfrow = c(2, 2))      # 设置2x2画布
#par(mar = c(3, 4, 3, 1))  # 设置边距 (下, 左, 上, 右)

# --- 图1: AR(4) ---
# 计算Y轴范围以包容所有线
ylim_1 <- range(c(y_real_subset, ar_mean_sub + 2*ar_se_sub, ar_mean_sub - 2*ar_se_sub))

plot(idx, y_real_subset, type = "l", col = "gray40", lwd = 1.2, ylim = ylim_1,
     main = "AR(4) [Static Variance]", ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "")
# 95% 静态置信区间 (几乎平行)
lines(idx, ar_mean_sub + 2*ar_se_sub, col = "blue", lty = 2)
lines(idx, ar_mean_sub - 2*ar_se_sub, col = "blue", lty = 2)
# 预测均值
lines(idx, ar_mean_sub, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topleft", c("Actual", "Pred", "95% CI"), col=c("gray40", "red", "blue"), lty=c(1,1,2), cex=0.7, bty="n")

# --- 图2: ARMA(2,1) ---
ylim_2 <- range(c(y_real_subset, arma_mean_sub + 2*arma_se_sub, arma_mean_sub - 2*arma_se_sub))

plot(idx, y_real_subset, type = "l", col = "gray40", lwd = 1.2, ylim = ylim_2,
     main = "ARMA(2,1) [Static Variance]", ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "")
lines(idx, arma_mean_sub + 2*arma_se_sub, col = "blue", lty = 2)
lines(idx, arma_mean_sub - 2*arma_se_sub, col = "blue", lty = 2)
lines(idx, arma_mean_sub, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topleft", c("Actual", "Pred", "95% CI"), col=c("gray40", "red", "blue"), lty=c(1,1,2), cex=0.7, bty="n")

# --- 图3: AR-GARCH ---
ylim_3 <- range(c(y_real_subset, arg_mean_sub + 2*arg_sigma_sub, arg_mean_sub - 2*arg_sigma_sub))

plot(idx, y_real_subset, type = "l", col = "gray40", lwd = 1.2, ylim = ylim_3,
     main = "AR-GARCH [Dynamic Variance]", ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "")
# 95% 动态置信区间 (随波动变化)
lines(idx, arg_mean_sub + 2*arg_sigma_sub, col = "blue", lty = 2)
lines(idx, arg_mean_sub - 2*arg_sigma_sub, col = "blue", lty = 2)
lines(idx, arg_mean_sub, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topleft", c("Actual", "Pred", "Dynamic CI"), col=c("gray40", "red", "blue"), lty=c(1,1,2), cex=0.7, bty="n")

# --- 图4: ARMA-GARCH ---
ylim_4 <- range(c(y_real_subset, armag_mean_sub + 2*armag_sigma_sub, armag_mean_sub - 2*armag_sigma_sub))

plot(idx, y_real_subset, type = "l", col = "gray40", lwd = 1.2, ylim = ylim_4,
     main = "ARMA-GARCH [Dynamic Variance]", ylab = "Log Returns", xlab = "")
lines(idx, armag_mean_sub + 2*armag_sigma_sub, col = "blue", lty = 2)
lines(idx, armag_mean_sub - 2*armag_sigma_sub, col = "blue", lty = 2)
lines(idx, armag_mean_sub, col = "red", lwd = 1.5)
legend("topleft", c("Actual", "Pred", "Dynamic CI"), col=c("gray40", "red", "blue"), lty=c(1,1,2), cex=0.7, bty="n")

# 恢复默认设置
par(mfrow = c(1, 1))
```
